QuestInfo.name: Sleepywood Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Sabitrama of Sleepywood is looking for a rare plant and needs help from travelers. Go to Sabitrama in Sleepywood.
QuestInfo.1: Sabitrama of Sleepywood tells you that rare Fire Flowers were recently found in Sleepywood dungeon. However, the monsters of the dungeon are eating the flowers. Sabitrama wants you to eliminate those monsters and bring him the flowers.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the Fire Flowers back to Sabitrama of Sleepywood. Sabitrama let out a sigh of relief, as the monsters could have eaten the Fire Flowers into extinction.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 800

0.0: I've heard that Fire Flowers, a very rare herbal medicine, were found inside Sleepywood Dungeon. Fire Flowers generate their own heat to survive the freezing winter. Since they are so rare, I was tending them everyday with care, but the monsters have gained a taste for them. I think I should retrieve the Fire Flowers eaten by the monsters.  Would you help me?
